purpose: Accuracy screen for a token-sparse, width-reduced MambaTS v3 architecture selected only by an isolated prediction-resource probe.
research_question: Can token-sparse MambaTS v3 preserve PEMS07 H12 validation accuracy while retaining a prediction-only latency lower than TimeMixer, Mamba2, and iTransformer at the same tensor geometry?
selection_history: The architecture was selected solely from the fixed synthetic PEMS07 resource probe: patch_stride=32 and d_model=16 reduced the scan length from 9713 to 2649 tokens. No validation loss from the seeds below was used in that choice.
evidence_boundary: Validation-only exploratory architecture probe on PEMS07 H12. No test metric is generated, inspected, or used for selection.
claim_boundary: A favorable result only justifies a four-PEMS confirmation matrix with contemporaneous baselines; it is not a publication or general time-series claim.
prelaunch_gates: verify PEMS07 fingerprint, M feature geometry, and train-only normalization contract
freeze sparse-token MambaTS v3 active/null executable graph and resource-selected dimensions
use fresh seeds and pair active with exact lambda-zero control
measure same-shape candidate resource use before interpreting an accuracy result

phases.name: pems07_h12_mambatsv3_lite_autocon_null
phases.purpose: Exact sparse-token AutoCon-capable graph with lambda zero.

phases.name: pems07_h12_mambatsv3_lite_autocon_active
phases.purpose: Exact sparse-token AutoCon-capable graph with lambda 0.001.

primary_contrasts: both variants versus the previously frozen PEMS07 TimeMixer mean, used only as a historical screen threshold
comparison_contract.noninferiority_margin: 0.01 relative validation MSE for the later contemporaneous confirmation only
comparison_contract.resource_contract: Candidate resource has already been measured with the PEMS07 B32 L96 C883 H12 synthetic protocol; rerun it from result config after training.
comparison_contract.publication_claim_boundary: No test-set, all-PEMS, long-horizon, or general time-series claim is permitted.

stopping_rules: Do not change architecture, lambda, seeds, or budget from this plan after observing results.
If both active and null are worse than the historical TimeMixer validation reference by more than 1%, stop the sparse-token route.
If the active/null direction is not reproducible, retain AutoCon as an implemented ablation but make no causal accuracy claim.
Do not release test metrics from this probe.
